claims: Venezuela won their first-ever World Baseball Classic championship on March 17, 2026.
Venezuela defeated the United States 3-2 in the World Baseball Classic final.
The World Baseball Classic final was at loanDepot Park in Miami, Florida.
Eugenio Suárez hit the go-ahead RBI double in the ninth inning.
The final score was Venezuela 3, USA 2.
Maikel Garcia (Venezuela) was named the tournament MVP.
Venezuela took a 2-0 lead early via a Maikel Garcia sacrifice fly.
Venezuela took a 2-0 lead early via a Wilyer Abreu home run.
Bryce Harper tied the game with a two-run homer in the eighth.
The USA finished as runners-up for the second consecutive tournament.
Players on the winning team received over $100,000 each, reported by The New York Times.
